hyp_o0_h5_ai_energy_infra.statement: The core problem may be interconnection/transmission bottlenecks rather than generation shortage

hyp_o0_h6_ai_energy_infra.statement: Efficiency/hardware improvements may offset part of AI workload growth
hyp_o0_h6_ai_energy_infra.status_change_rationale: arXiv 2411.11540 found Google's hyperscale PUE near theoretical limit (~1.1) yet total energy consumption rose 3.7x from 2016-2022, i.e. efficiency gains did NOT offset aggregate growth in their dataset (a Jevons-paradox dynamic). Evidence is about general cloud computing, not AI-specific workloads (AI_ATTRIBUTION: INDIRECT), so this weakens but does not reject H6.

uncertainty.detail: paper's dataset predates/straddles the generative-AI boom and is not AI-workload-specific
